nl_statement: Explain why the binomial coefficient “n choose 0” equals 1 and the binomial coefficient “n choose n” equals 1.
difficulty_rationale: Both parts are boundary identities for binomial coefficients and simplify by their definitions; provisional rating pending rubric review.
